name: kits
description: Learn-by-building toolkit: a stack-neutral delivery pipeline (plan, Event Storming, test-first build, two reviewers, human review, Kubernetes deploy) and stack packs that supply verified knowledge.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: The delivery pipeline for any stack: /setup-project, /grill-with-docs, /wayfinder, /to-spec, /to-tickets, /implement, /human-review, /deploy, /retro, /next, /project-explorer, the event-storming discipline, the core skills, seven agents, the merge guard and a ruleset that protects main.

plugins.name: spring
plugins.description: Spring pack: Spring Boot 4, testing with Testcontainers, transactions, JPA, modern Java, concurrency, logging, the Spring review checklist, and verified build and deploy templates (Dockerfile, CI, Kustomize, deploy workflow).

plugins.name: e2e
plugins.description: End-to-end testing: Playwright Test against the app and its infrastructure in Testcontainers, the e2e-tester agent, and the Playwright MCP limited to localhost.

plugins.name: spring-ai
plugins.description: Calling a model from a Spring service with the Anthropic Java SDK: structured outputs, prompt injection, stop reasons, caching, cost, evals as tests, synthetic data, and a review checklist.

plugins.name: spring-web
plugins.description: A React 19 + Vite + TanStack Query front end for a Spring Boot API, served by nginx, with accessible markup that matches the e2e selectors.
